title: Synergistic Cytotoxicity of Cafestol and Kahweol With Doxorubicin in Breast Cancer Cells Involves TNF‑alpha Targeting and NF‑kappaB Downregulation.
authors: Souza, Layane D; Novaes, Fabio Junior M; Passos, Carlos Luan A; de Amorim, Isis S S; Nicolau-Neto, Pedro; Rodrigues, Juliana A; Teixeira, Adilson F; Ferreira, Christian; Dos Santos, Nathalia Alexia N; Camargo, Priscila G; Bispo, Marcelle L F; Lima, Camilo Henrique S; Pires, Bruno Ricardo B; Fonseca, Adenilson de Sousa da; Rezende, Claudia M; Fialho, Eliane; Mencalha, Andre Luiz
one_liner_zh: 该文研究咖啡醇和咖啡豆醇与阿霉素在乳腺癌中的协同细胞毒性，涉及TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB通路，仅用分子对接预测小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Breast cancer (BC) is the most common cancer in women worldwide. Natural compounds have been studied to improve chemotherapy efficiency. Cafestol and kahweol (C&K) are diterpenes from coffee lipid fraction, with potential anticancer activity, whose effects and association with chemotherapeutic drug doxorubicin in BC cells are still unknown. Here, we evaluated the synergistic cytotoxic effects of the C&K with doxorubicin and their molecular mechanisms in BC cells. Cell viability was assessed by the MTT assay. Flow cytometry was used to analyze apoptosis, cell cycle, and NF-kappaB levels. The microarray assay was performed to identify altered signaling pathways, and molecular docking was utilized to predict the interaction between C&K and TNF-alpha. In addition, TCGA data were explored to evaluate the clinical association between the expression of C&K-regulated genes and TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB pathway genes. C&K was cytotoxic and increased the doxorubicin cytotoxicity, augmented the sub-G0/G1 phase, downregulated TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB pathway, decreased NF-kappaB protein levels, and showed affinity for TNF-alpha by molecular docking. Moreover, considering the C&K-modulated genes, BLOC1S1 acted as a protective factor for BC, and these genes were negatively correlated with TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB genes. Our data suggest that C&K have cytotoxic properties by inhibiting TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB pathway and interacting synergistically with doxorubicin in BC cells.
abstract_zh: 乳腺癌（BC）是全球女性中最常见的癌症。已有研究探索天然化合物以提高化疗效率。咖啡醇（cafestol）和咖啡豆醇（kahweol）（C&K）是来自咖啡脂质部分的二萜类化合物，具有潜在的抗癌活性，但其在乳腺癌细胞中的效应及与化疗药物多柔比星（doxorubicin）的联合作用尚不明确。在此，我们评估了C&K与多柔比星在乳腺癌细胞中的协同细胞毒性效应及其分子机制。通过MTT实验测定细胞活力。使用流式细胞术分析细胞凋亡、细胞周期及NF-kappaB水平。进行微阵列实验以识别改变的信号通路，并利用分子对接预测C&K与TNF-alpha之间的相互作用。此外，利用TCGA数据评估C&K调控基因表达与TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB通路基因之间的临床关联。C&K具有细胞毒性，增强多柔比星的细胞毒性，增加亚G0/G1期细胞比例，下调TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB通路，降低NF-kappaB蛋白水平，并通过分子对接显示对TNF-alpha具有亲和力。此外，考虑到C&K调控的基因，BLOC1S1作为乳腺癌的保护因子，且这些基因与TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB基因呈负相关。我们的数据表明，C&K通过抑制TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB通路发挥细胞毒性特性，并在乳腺癌细胞中与多柔比星协同作用。
